label: Bus
meaning: Bus or BRT only when named by user; icon alone does not identify operator.

label: Tram
meaning: Street-running rail when supplied context matches.

label: Rail
meaning: Rail service; add operator/service name in text.

label: Urban rail
meaning: Urban rail context; no automatic MRT/LRT claim.

label: Water transport
meaning: Passenger vessel only when explicitly labeled.

label: Air transport
meaning: Air connection or airport context.

label: Cycling
meaning: Cycling connection, not automatically an available rental service.

label: Walking connection
meaning: Abstract walking link; do not infer a specific accessible route.

label: Location
meaning: Point/location; a pin is not proof of coverage.

label: Route
meaning: Path or route concept; no geographic accuracy implied.

label: Wayfinding
meaning: Directions or information context.

label: Ticket
meaning: Ticketing concept; not a real valid ticket or QR credential.

label: Time
meaning: Time/waiting/headway; state unit and measure.

label: Schedule
meaning: Service calendar; actual dates need evidence.

label: Transfer
meaning: Transfer/exchange; label if ambiguous.

label: Passenger
meaning: Person/passenger concept; no count by icon multiplication.

label: Mobility access
meaning: Wheelchair/mobility-access context. Actual facilities require evidence; this is not a compliance certification.

label: Seating
meaning: Seating availability only with evidence; not automatically priority seating.

label: Luggage
meaning: Luggage context, not an operator baggage allowance.

label: Payment
meaning: Payment concept; accepted methods require confirmation.

label: People
meaning: Group or stakeholders; not automatically passengers.

label: Next step
meaning: Direction/sequence in context.

label: Confirmed / complete
meaning: Only if supported by stated evidence or use as neutral list marker.

label: Attention
meaning: Needs written issue/threshold; never color alone.

label: Information
meaning: Explanation/caveat.

label: Assurance
meaning: Security/safety concept, not certification or guaranteed safety.

label: Analysis
meaning: Data/analysis concept, not a miniature quantitative chart.

label: Document
meaning: Source/report/record.

label: Budget
meaning: Financial context; does not represent a currency.

label: Communication
meaning: Feedback/contact context.

label: Search / inspect
meaning: Search or investigation in context.
